description: Teleport auth image. The upstream tag lives twice, in eng/maestra/UPSTREAM_VERSION (the source build) and in the teleport-distroless FROM (the stock base): one grouped PR bumps both, and build-and-push.yml fails when they differ. Run by the hosted Mend Renovate app, like eventrouter.

customManagers.description: Upstream gravitational/teleport tag built from source.

packageRules.description: Source tag and stock base move together. Majors stay manual: a Teleport major is a cluster upgrade (auth first, one major at a time) and the patches may need porting.
Stay on the Go line upstream releases with (the stock binary reports it in `teleport version`); a new Go minor is a deliberate bump.
